This '''marketplace''' was a location in [[Cuipernam]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] explored this marketplace during the [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|Mission to Ansion]]. While in the marketplace, Offee was lured into a shop and drugged by [[Kyakhta]] and [[Bulgan]], two clanless [[Ansionian]] [[Gender/Legends|males]] on the order of [[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin|Soergg the Hutt]], who wished to prevent the Jedi from completing their mission, which was to ensure Ansion did not secede from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />
